import sys

MAXN = 510

total_nodes, max_edges, prime_mod = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

binom = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
f1_arr = [0] * (MAXN)
f2_arr = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
g1_arr = [0] * (MAXN)
g2_arr = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]

# Compute binomial coefficients modulo prime_mod
for i in range(total_nodes + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == 0:
            binom[i][j] = 1
        else:
            binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j]) % prime_mod

# Initialize f1 and g1 arrays
f1_arr[0] = 1
for i in range(1, total_nodes + 1):
    f1_arr[i] = 0
    g1_arr[i] = 0
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f1_arr[i] = (f1_arr[i] + f1_arr[j - 1] * f1_arr[i - j] % prime_mod * binom[i - 1][j - 1]) % prime_mod
        temp = ((f1_arr[j - 1] * g1_arr[i - j] + g1_arr[j - 1] * f1_arr[i - j]) % prime_mod)
        temp = (temp * (i + 1)) % prime_mod
        g1_arr[i] = (g1_arr[i] + (f1_arr[j - 1] * f1_arr[i - j] % prime_mod * (binom[j][2] + binom[i - j + 1][2]) + temp) % prime_mod * binom[i - 1][j - 1]) % prime_mod
    f1_arr[i] = ((i + 1) * f1_arr[i]) % prime_mod

# Initialize g2 and f2 arrays
g2_arr[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, total_nodes + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, max_edges) + 1):
        f2_arr[i][j] = f2_arr[i - 1][j]
        g2_arr[i][j] = g2_arr[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            temp_f = f2_arr[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            f2_arr[i][j] = (f2_arr[i][j] + temp_f * f1_arr[k] % prime_mod * binom[j][k]) % prime_mod
            temp_g = f2_arr[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            g_part = (temp_g * g1_arr[k] + (g2_arr[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 0) * f1_arr[k]) % prime_mod
            g2_arr[i][j] = (g2_arr[i][j] + g_part * binom[j][k]) % prime_mod

print(g2_arr[total_nodes][max_edges])
